about: GTA 6 pre-load (Delta, pillar 6). Rockstar Newswire Nov 3 2026: digital pre-load from Nov 10 (PS5 midnight local; Xbox Series X|S 12 a.m. GMT), the pre-load file needs up to 212 GB depending on device, code-in-box versions for both consoles from Nov 12, launch Nov 19. PlayStation's GTA VI support page: 212 GB, code-in-box has no disc, releases midnight local Nov 19 on PS5, check space under Settings > Storage. Voice is date-proof for posting Nov 10-12: no 'today', no dated count in the present tense. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six needs up to two hundred twelve gigs.
